Eli: Heads up — someone bribed me with office donuts and now I'm emotionally compromised. who took the blueberry box? :donut:
Tara: Not me! I left a Post-it: "DO NOT TOUCH - FOR TARA" and yet... :sob:
Jules: I briefly considered, then did the right thing and brought donuts instead. moral boost delivered. :raised_hands:
Marcus: Confession: I hid one donut in my drawer for post-standup recovery. it was for the greater good. :innocent:
Eli: Evidence? open the drawer, Marcus. :detective:
Marcus: Can't. Currently presenting at standup. but I will surrender one after. :handshake:
Tara: Poll: next time should we label snacks with initials, or start a snack rota? ```/poll "Snack policy" "Initial labels" "Snack rota" "Trust and chaos"```
ops-bot: Poll created by Tara — vote with the buttons on the message. (system)
Eli: Also quick PSA: coffee creamer options running low. vote: oat, almond, regular? I'll pick up whichever wins. :coffee:
Jules: Oat milk please. makes the coffee feel fancy. :sparkles:
Marcus: Regular wins my heart. classic. :heart:
Tara: Almond for me, but I'll take whatever bale of creamer survivors leave. :grin:
Eli: Results in 20 mins. loser buys morning pastries next week. stakes = delicious. :money_with_wings:
ops-bot: Fridge temp: 36C. No anomalies. (system)
